scripts.update: uv run scripts/update_deps.py && pnpm i --lockfile-only && cd server && uv lock
scripts.sync: pnpm i && cd server && uv sync --all-groups
scripts.app:start: cd app/packages/main && pnpm exec vite dev --port 5173
scripts.server:setup-for-test: cd server && cross-env-shell EXCALIBUR_ROOT_FOLDER=excalibur-test-files "uv run excalibur init -r"
scripts.server:start: cd server && uv run excalibur start --port 8989 --debug --no-log
scripts.server:start-for-test: cross-env-shell EXCALIBUR_ROOT_FOLDER=excalibur-test-files "pnpm run server:setup-for-test && pnpm run server:start"
scripts.server:post-test-reset: cross-env-shell EXCALIBUR_ROOT_FOLDER=excalibur-test-files "cd server && uv run excalibur reset -y"
scripts.cy:e2e: start-server-and-test server:start-for-test http://localhost:8989/api/docs "start-server-and-test app:start http://localhost:5173 cy:open && pnpm run server:post-test-reset"
scripts.test:server: cd server && uv run excalibur test
scripts.test:e2e: start-server-and-test server:start-for-test http://localhost:8989/api/docs "start-server-and-test app:start http://localhost:5173 cy:run && pnpm run server:post-test-reset"
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:component && pnpm run test:server && pnpm run test:e2e
